name: plan-p1-straight-talk-local
about: A planned campaign (V2c, prompt v5): the P1 starter preset written from the idea the Strategist recorded for "local-missed-requirement" — the plain terms of a local job, before any benefit. Every candidate should lead with the idea and state only the brief's facts.

area.label: Fixture Yard, IL
area.reason: Fixture: drivers within a day's drive of the yard.

recipe.name: From the driver's seat
recipe.hook_formula: Say plainly what the run is, as if from the driver's seat: the lanes or the area, then the schedule or home time the brief states. If the brief states no lanes or area, say the kind of run (local, regional, over the road). Then what we need, if the brief states it (experience, licence, endorsements). No pay figure in the hook unless the brief states nothing else.
recipe.image_prompt_template: View through a truck windshield from the driver's seat, {viewpoint}, an open {road} ahead through {setting}, {light}, {weather}, no text, no logos, no lettering

angle.idea: Lead with the plain terms of the job: Class A, the stated experience requirement and touch freight, before any benefit.
angle.proof: The opening is Class A local delivery, states a years requirement and involves touch freight.
